title: Joyful Movement Life Skills: Comprehensive Apparatus Training
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Joyful Movement Life Skills: Comprehensive Apparatus Training
outcomes: Select the appropriate design and implementation for physical and wellness-based training and mind-body awareness from an anatomical approach for general conditioning, back and joint pain, fall prevention for seniors, pre/post-natal exercise, with a mindful understanding of how to work with various body types.

Comprehensive Training: Successful students will demonstrate, synthesize, and evaluate proper Pilates Apparatus exercises and their application to train and modify for intergenerational populations with diverse body types and fitness levels.
